lines.text: 나무 그늘에서 사자가 쿨쿨 낮잠을 자요.
lines.en: The lion is taking a nap in the shade of a tree. Zzz!
segs: The lion is taking a nap in the shade of a tree. Zzz!

lines.text: 사자 코를 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap the lion's nose!

lines.text: 콧방울이 퐁! 그래도 사자는 쿨쿨 자요.
lines.en: The nose bubble goes pop! But the lion keeps on sleeping.
segs: The nose bubble goes pop! But the lion keeps on sleeping.

lines.text: 작은 생쥐가 산책을 나왔어요. 풀이 숲처럼 커다래요!
lines.en: A little mouse comes out for a walk. The grass is as big as a forest!
segs: A little mouse comes out for a walk. The grass is as big as a forest!

lines.text: 화면을 톡톡 눌러서 폴짝폴짝 가 볼까요?
lines.en: Let's tap the screen and hop along!
segs: Let's tap the screen and hop along!

lines.text: 화면을 톡톡 눌러서 폴짝!
lines.en: Tap the screen to hop!

lines.text: 어? 이건 뭐지? 폴짝!
lines.en: Huh? What's this? Hop!

lines.text: 와아! 사자 갈기는 커다란 미끄럼틀이었어요. 쭈르륵~ 히히!
lines.en: Wheee! The lion's mane was a great big slide. Whoosh! Hee hee!
segs: The lion's mane was a great big slide.

lines.text: 어? 사자가 눈을 떴어요!
lines.en: Oh? The lion's eyes are open!
segs: Oh? The lion's eyes are open!

lines.text: 사자가 커다란 앞발로 생쥐 꼬리를 탁! 눌렀어요.
lines.en: The lion pressed the mouse's tail with a big paw. Thump!

lines.text: 사자가 하품하며 말했어요. "하암~ 한입에 꿀꺽 해 버릴까?"
lines.en: The lion yawned and said, "Haaah... shall I gobble you up in one bite?"
segs: "Haaah... shall I gobble you up in one bite?"

lines.text: 생쥐가 말했어요. "살려 주시면 꼭 은혜 갚을게요!"
lines.en: The mouse said, "If you let me go, I promise I'll pay you back!"
segs: "If you let me go, I promise I'll pay you back!"

lines.text: 생쥐를 톡 눌러서 부탁해 봐요.
lines.en: Tap the mouse to ask nicely.
segs: Tap the mouse to ask nicely.

lines.text: 생쥐를 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap the mouse!

lines.text: 생쥐가 두 손을 모았어요. "제발요, 사자님~"
lines.en: The mouse put both hands together. "Please, Lion, please!"
segs: The mouse put both hands together.

lines.text: "네가? 나를 도와준다고?"
lines.en: "You? You'll help me?"

lines.text: 사자가 웃다가 앞발이 스르르 열렸어요. 앞발을 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: The lion laughed, and the big paw slowly opened. Tap the paw!
segs: The lion laughed, and the big paw slowly opened. Tap the paw!

lines.text: 사자 앞발을 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap the lion's paw!

lines.text: 생쥐가 쏙 빠져나왔어요. "고맙습니다, 사자님!"
lines.en: The mouse slipped right out. "Thank you, Lion!"

lines.text: 사자 발과 생쥐를 나란히 놓아 볼까요?
lines.en: Let's put the lion's paw and the mouse side by side!
segs: Let's put the lion's paw and the mouse side by side!

lines.text: 사자 발가락 하나가 생쥐 한 마리만 해요!
lines.en: One lion toe is as big as a whole mouse!
segs: One lion toe is as big as a whole mouse!

lines.text: 더 큰 발자국은 어느 쪽일까요?
lines.en: Which footprint is bigger?

lines.text: 더 큰 발자국을 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap the bigger footprint!

lines.text: 두 발자국을 잘 봐요. 어느 쪽이 더 커다랗지?
lines.en: Look at the two footprints. Which one is bigger?
segs: Look at the two footprints. Which one is bigger?

lines.text: 사자가 가진 발자국이에요. 반짝이는 쪽을 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: That's the lion's footprint. Tap the sparkly one!
segs: That's the lion's footprint. Tap the sparkly one!

lines.text: 맞아요! 사자 발자국이에요.
lines.en: That's right! It's the lion's footprint.
segs: That's right! It's the lion's footprint.

lines.text: 이번엔 이빨이에요. 더 작은 이빨은 어느 쪽일까요?
lines.en: Now it's teeth. Which tooth is smaller?
segs: Now it's teeth. Which tooth is smaller?

lines.text: 더 작은 이빨을 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap the smaller tooth!

lines.text: 콩알처럼 조그만 이빨을 찾아봐요!
lines.en: Look for the teeny tiny tooth, as small as a bean!
segs: Look for the teeny tiny tooth, as small as a bean!

lines.text: 생쥐가 가진 이빨이에요. 반짝이는 쪽을 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: That's the mouse's tooth. Tap the sparkly one!
segs: That's the mouse's tooth. Tap the sparkly one!

lines.text: 맞아요! 생쥐 이빨이에요.
lines.en: That's right! It's the mouse's tooth.
segs: That's right! It's the mouse's tooth.

lines.text: 생쥐 이빨은 작지만 아주 튼튼해요. 사각사각 뭐든 갉을 수 있지요.
lines.en: The mouse's teeth are small, but very strong. Nibble, nibble! They can gnaw anything.

lines.text: 좁은 구멍이 있어요. 쏙 들어갈 수 있는 건 누구일까요?
lines.en: There's a tiny hole. Who can squeeze right in?
segs: There's a tiny hole. Who can squeeze right in?

lines.text: 구멍에 쏙 들어갈 친구를 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap the friend who can squeeze into the hole!
segs: Tap the friend who can squeeze into the hole!

lines.text: 사자는 너무 커서 코가 쿵! 부딪혀요. 작은 친구는 누구지?
lines.en: The lion is too big. Bonk! Its nose bumps the hole. Who is the little friend?
segs: The lion is too big. Bonk! Its nose bumps the hole. Who is the little friend?

lines.text: 생쥐가 들어갈 수 있어요. 반짝이는 친구를 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: The mouse can fit! Tap the sparkly friend!
segs: The mouse can fit! Tap the sparkly friend!

lines.text: 맞아요! 작은 생쥐는 좁은 구멍도 쏙!
lines.en: That's right! The little mouse slips right into the tiny hole!
segs: That's right! The little mouse slips right into the tiny hole!

lines.text: 크면 큰 대로, 작으면 작은 대로 다 쓸모가 있어요.
lines.en: Big or small, everyone is useful.

lines.text: 밤이 되었어요. 앗, 사자가 그물에 걸렸어요!
lines.en: Night came. Oh no, the lion is caught in a net!
segs: Night came. Oh no, the lion is caught in a net!

lines.text: 사자가 버둥버둥, 그래도 그물이 풀리지 않아요.
lines.en: The lion wiggles and wriggles, but the net won't come loose.
segs: The lion wiggles and wriggles, but the net won't come loose.

lines.text: 쫑긋! 생쥐가 사자 목소리를 들었어요.
lines.en: Ears up! The mouse heard the lion's voice.

lines.text: "사자님, 제가 도와 드릴게요!"
lines.en: "Lion, I'll help you!"

lines.text: 생쥐가 작은 이빨로 그물을 갉아요. 톡톡 눌러서 한 줄씩 끊어 봐요!
lines.en: The mouse gnaws the net with tiny teeth. Tap, tap to cut one rope at a time!
segs: The mouse gnaws the net with tiny teeth. Tap, tap to cut one rope at a time!

lines.text: 하나
lines.en: One

lines.text: 둘
lines.en: Two

lines.text: 셋
lines.en: Three

lines.text: 넷
lines.en: Four

lines.text: 다섯
lines.en: Five

lines.text: 여섯
lines.en: Six

lines.text: 일곱
lines.en: Seven

lines.text: 여덟
lines.en: Eight

lines.text: 아홉
lines.en: Nine

lines.text: 열
lines.en: Ten

lines.text: 톡톡 눌러서 그물을 갉아요!
lines.en: Tap, tap to gnaw the net!
segs: Tap, tap to gnaw the net!

lines.text: 하나, 둘, 셋… 열! 그물 줄 열 개를 다 끊었어요!
lines.en: One, two, three... ten! All ten ropes are cut!
segs: One, two, three... ten! All ten ropes are cut!

lines.text: 와아! 사자가 풀려났어요!
lines.en: Hooray! The lion is free!

lines.text: "고마워, 작은 친구. 작은 이빨이 나를 구해 줬구나!"
lines.en: "Thank you, little friend. Your tiny teeth saved me!"
segs: "Thank you, little friend. Your tiny teeth saved me!"

lines.text: "제가 은혜 갚는다고 했지요?"
lines.en: "Didn't I say I'd pay you back?"
segs: "Didn't I say I'd pay you back?"

lines.text: 다음 날 아침, 사자가 생쥐를 등에 태웠어요. "꽉 잡아!"
lines.en: The next morning, the lion put the mouse on its back. "Hold tight!"
segs: The next morning, the lion put the mouse on its back.

lines.text: 옆으로 쓱 밀어서 달려요!
lines.en: Swipe sideways to run!

lines.text: 바람을 가르며 초원을 달려요! 신난다!
lines.en: They race across the meadow through the wind! Yippee!
segs: They race across the meadow through the wind!

lines.text: 사자랑 생쥐를 톡톡 눌러 봐요. 같이 웃어요!
lines.en: Tap the lion and the mouse. Let's laugh together!
segs: Tap the lion and the mouse. Let's laugh together!

lines.text: 그날부터 사자와 생쥐는 둘도 없는 친구가 되었답니다.
lines.en: From that day on, the lion and the mouse were the best of friends.
segs: From that day on, the lion and the mouse were the best of friends.

cut_paw: The lion pressed the mouse's tail with a big paw. Thump!
cut_laugh: Ha ha ha! This tiny little thing?
The lion laughs so hard, it holds its belly.
cut_net: Oh no, somebody please help me!
The lion is caught in the net and wriggles.

ui.작아도 큰 친구를 도울 수 있어요!: Even someone small can help a big friend!
ui.작은 친구의 큰 힘: The big power of a small friend
